verdict.rationale: Cekura documents an official MCP server and Skills plugin that let AI assistants such as Claude Code and Cursor manage voice-agent testing and observability from the dev environment. It also offers a CLI and SDK for runs and call data, and a published OpenAPI spec for programmatic access. Together these give an agent API and MCP paths to call logs, runs and evaluation results. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the MCP/API tools query traces (e.g. LiveKit tracing spans) and metric/eval results for debugging, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven debugging workflows.
